idea-plugin.name: Throwable Highlighter
idea-plugin.description:
Highlights Java classes that inherit from Throwable.

Throwable highlighting is applied to class declarations and references, including usages in fields, local variables, constructors, catch clauses, throws clauses, and inheritance declarations.

The highlighting style can be configured under Editor | Color Scheme | Throwable Highlighter.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0

  • Adds configurable highlighting for import of Throwable subclasses.
  • Highlights only the imported class name.
  • Import highlighting inherits the Throwable class color by default.

1.0.0

  • Highlights Java classes inheriting from Throwable.
  • Highlights both class declarations and references.
  • Supports transitive Throwable inheritance.
  • Adds configurable highlighting under the IDE color scheme settings.
